title: Bridge to 1B — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: CHEM 1B readiness review (CHEM 1A → CHEM 1B). Learn Trail with 11 stops: watch a worked example step by step, then solve one yourself. Practice Quests with Mixed Practice and 11 topics: Core Toolkit, Mole Match (limiting reactants), Acid–Base Stoichiometry and titrations, Dissolution Lab (ions and concentrations), Predicting & Balancing, Reactions in Water (net ionic, precipitation, neutralization), REDOX Refresh, Lewis Workshop (interactive Lewis builder), Shape & Hybridization, MO Explorer, and Matter & Energy. A 12-question Readiness Check weighted toward what CHEM 1B uses most (acid–base and solution stoichiometry, ions in water, REDOX, energy) gives a personal review plan with OpenStax Chemistry 2e chapters. Includes solution maps, hints, step reveals, Yellow and Green Sheets, XP, ranks, achievements, and matched ItsDrDan videos. Add ?mode=check to open the Readiness Check.
